book.name: EZEQUIEL
book.title: A Slolonel Dios D'a Vin̈aj EZEQUIEL

content: A tas alb'ilcan d'a yib'an̈ lum Seir
Ix yalanxi Jehová d'ayin icha tic:
Ach anima, ixic q'uelan d'a stojolal lum tzalquixtac yic Seir. Tzalan in lolonel d'a yib'an̈ luum.

content.text: A Jehová Yajal tz'alan icha tic: Ex cajan ex d'a tzalquixtac yic Seir, a in svala' to ay cot voval d'ayex, ol vac'och yaelal d'a eyib'an̈, ol vac'can tz'inan e chon̈ab', ol mac'joccanem lan̈najoc.
A juntzan̈ e chon̈ab', ol in satel d'a juneln̈ej. Ol vac'can tz'inan. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyuuj to a in ton Jehová in svutej icha chi'

content: Yujto ayexn̈ejoch ajc'olal d'a chon̈ab' Israel, e milnaccham eb' ayic ayoch syaelal eb' yuj smul.
Yuj chi' a in Dios Yajal in svac' in ti' to ol ex vac'canoch d'a yol sc'ab' chamel, axo chamel chi' ol ex pechan b'eyec'oc, ol ex cham yuuj.
Ol vac'can tz'inan lum tzalquixtac Seir chi', man̈xo ol in cha ec' anima ta'.
Ol vac'can b'ud'joc el lum tzalquixtac, lum ch'olquixtac yed' yoltac a a' yuj snivanil eb' chamnac, aton eb' ol cham d'a oval.
Juneln̈ej ol vac'can tz'inan lum e luum chi', man̈xalaj mach olto cajnajcan d'a e chon̈ab' chi'. Icha chi' ol aj eyojtacaneli to a in ton Jehová in svutej icha chi'.
A ex tic eyojtac to a in Jehová in ayinec' yed' eb' israel tic, palta tzeyalan icha tic: A smacb'en Israel yed' Judá, quic ol ajcanoc, xe comon chiej.

Palta a in Dios Yajal in svac' in ti' to icha val yoval e c'ool yed' e chichonc'olal ayoch d'a Israel tic, icha pax chi' ol ex vutej. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel yuj eb' israel to a in svac'och eyaelal yuj tas ix eyutej eb'.

Icha chi' ol aj eyojtacaneli to a in Jehová in ix vab' val e b'uchval lolonel ayic ix eyalan icha tic: A lum tzalquixtac d'a yol smacb'en Israel, ix can val tz'inan luum. Co maquec quiquej luum, xe chi.
Ix eyic' val chaan̈ e b'a d'ayin, ix in e b'uchani, palta ix vab'n̈ej tas ix eyal chi'.
A in Dios Yajal in sval juntzan̈ tic: Masanil yolyib'an̈q'uinal tic ol tzalajq'ueoc ayic ol ex in satanel chi'.

Yujto a ex tic, ix ex te tzalaji ayic ix lajviel chon̈ab' Israel, yuj chi' ol in pactzitej d'ayex icha ix eyutej e b'a chi'. Ol vac'can tz'inan lum tzalquixtac Seir chi', aton e macb'en ex yin̈tilalcan Edom. Icha chi' ol aj eyojtacaneli to a in ton Jehová in svutej icha chi', xchi Jehová, xa chi d'a eb', xchi d'ayin.
